name: Yoshino Sakura
source:
Favorite food: Japanese confectionery
Disliked food: Green peppers, carbonated beverages

A woman who is deeply tied with Ricca and Kiyotaka. She knows a lot about Hatsunejima and magic.

[spoiler]
Actually the granddaughter of [url=/c12822]Ricca[/url] and [url=/c12804]Kiyotaka[/url] in their previous life.

In D.C.III D.D, Sakura returns the wand of her grandparents to her reincarnated grandparents. [url=/c5310]Rikka[/url] receiving Yoshitaka wand and [url=/c5316]Yoshitaka[/url] receiving Ricca wand.

[/spoiler]
